description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Jayasinghe Mudiyanselage Chandradasa Jayasinghe as Deputy Mayor of the Ratnapura Municipal Council and Mr. Wedige Nimal Yasasiri Peiris as a member of the Moratuwa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Ratnapura Municipal Council and Moratuwa Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected officials to fill positions that have become vacant due to appointment as Mayor and death. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election results for government positions.
